configuration_map: No geometric configuration exists. All entities are magnitudes (lengths a, b, c, d and areas X, Y, S, T, Q) related by ratios and commensurability. The proof manipulates these algebraically: it uses proportionality (6.16) to equate cross-rectangles, distributive laws (2.1) to expand products, and commensurability transitivity (10.12, 10.15, 10.19) to chain commensurability relations. No points are placed in space, no figures are constructed with spatial relationships, and no angular or positional claims are made.
skip_reason: The proof is purely algebraic/proportional. It concerns commensurability relations among rational magnitudes (lengths and rectangular areas) with no geometric configuration claims — no point positions, ray orderings, angle decompositions, or inside/outside assertions. Book 10 propositions of this type involve irrational/rational magnitude classification, not spatial geometry.
